title: Hearty Homemade Malaysian Chicken Noodles
description: A resinous and savory Malaysian dish featuring yellow onion and rest-meat, perfect for a brunch mood, this ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly recipe is sure to satisfy your cravings. It has a cheese-pull effect that will leave you wanting more.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced onion to the skillet and cook until it starts to caramelize, about 5 minutes.
Add the malaysian curry powder to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Pour in the coconut milk and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the sauce simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Cook the rice noodles according to the package instructions and drain well.
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and toss to combine with the sauce and chicken.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
If using cheese, sprinkle it on top of the noodles and let it melt.
